# Laptop Hub Kenya

> Laptop Hub Kenya is a Nairobi-based shop selling brand new, refurbished and ex-UK laptops plus accessories such as chargers, batteries, RAM, SSDs, bags, keyboards and docking stations. Prices are in Kenyan Shillings and orders are placed by WhatsApp or phone call.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Shop overview, featured stock and categories.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse and filter all laptops and accessories by category, condition, brand and price.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email, shop location and opening hours.
- [Sign in](/auth): Staff sign in for shop administration.
